pattern.top_pattern: NY authorized acute hospital pressure is concentrated at NYU Langone Hospital Long Island
pattern.what_is_impacting: NY / PPO Local / ACUTE HOSPITAL / authorized inpatient care
pattern.pattern_details: In NY, authorized PPO Local acute hospital spend is concentrated almost entirely at NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL LONG ISLAND. Both admissions and paid per admit increased, making this a combined utilization and reimbursement pressure point rather than a pure volume change. The concentration at one provider makes the issue highly actionable.
pattern.why_it_matters: A single hospital is driving a material increase, so targeted contract and utilization work can move results quickly.
pattern.recommended_next_step: Escalate NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL LONG ISLAND for focused network and UM review, including admission appropriateness, case management, and reimbursement performance on the growing inpatient cases.
evidence_summary: NYU LANGONE HOSPITAL LONG ISLAND added about +$1.3M.
Admissions increased by 47 while paid per admit increased by about $2.8K.
The signal is concentrated enough to support provider-specific action rather than a broad NY response.
